name: ingest-document
description: Learn attached documents (books, handbooks, policies, articles) into a base memory: the facts, relations, rules and procedures they state, as validated knowledge wires with provenance (source, location, quote). Use when the user asks to learn, ingest, remember or add a document to a knowledge base.

rights.description: the source rights of the attachments, as the user stated them (DS011); required: without it nothing is ingested

purpose.description: what the knowledge will be used for, in the user's words

source_url.description: where the document comes from, when the user gave it

tier.description: the model tier that writes the knowledge wires

_note: Wraps the product's direct ingestion (lib/ingest, Ingestions.draft): chunking along the document's structure, the sop-wire-authoring skill, the knowledge validator and the source checks in the repair loop, memory conflict checks, and storage with provenance. The adapter only routes its model calls through the endpoint's tier, tagged with the task's purpose and run id.
